close_reason: Landed. CustomTransportBuilder is a chainable builder with add_root_der/add_root_pem/add_roots_pem_bundle for multi-root trust chains and with_client_cert for mTLS. build() returns BuilderTransport, a Clone TransportConfig impl. Pure-additive — CustomCaTransport keeps its existing API. parse_all_pem_certs helper added alongside parse_first_pem_cert for the multi-cert bundle path. Seven new unit tests cover parser-level multi-bundle handling, happy-path multi-root and single-root build, error paths (bogus PEM, empty bundle, invalid client cert), and a Debug-redaction tripwire matching the CustomCaTransport pattern.
title: Builder API for CustomCaTransport: multi-root, intermediates, mTLS
